profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Trabus Technologies
profile.summary: Working on a variety of data science projects, focusing on machine learning, databases and web development at Trabus Technologies

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led development and deployment of containerized full stack application with PostgreSQL database, FastAPI backend and React frontend to provide ML model outputs to Navy fleet schedulers.
- Wrote testing suite for application using pytest and playwright and added to GitLab CI pipeline
- Built Kong API Gateway to provide rate-limited access to REST APIs
positions.insights: Leading Development Teams, Python and +2 skills

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Building ML models to predict workforce staffing requirements and identify probability of on-time completion
- Developing full stack application with FastAPI backend and javascript frontend to display schedule statistics and model output for end users
- Creating Electron app to provide ML models to end users with easy-to-use interface and small footprint

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Working on projects combining databases, machine learning models, and front end displays/dashboards
-Processing and efficiently storing streaming geospatial data with tens of millions of rows per hour
-Training and deploying a variety of different ML models to predict river levels and barge travel times
-Creating a graph network to efficiently determine connections on inland waterway system
-Creating dashboards with geospatial data in Mapbox, as well as charts and graphs using various javascript libraries, usually in a Django framework
-Deploying webapps via docker containers on AWS
-Creating REST and GraphQL APIs as well as AWS Lamba serverless functions for a web-based tool to provide relevant info to mariners

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Wrote performance verification test procedure documents for submarine sonar displays
- Automated and simplified performance tests by creating MATLAB signal processing programs for submarines and surface ships
- Utilized aforementioned tools and procedures to successfully pass and implement new hardware/software baselines on the US Navy fleet of submarines

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked with Professor Todd Averett in his nuclear physics lab. Job duties included programming, both to simulate laser optics or control electronics, as well as machining parts, building vacuum systems, and analyzing data.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Wrote code in C++ and python to produce diagnostic plots for the calibrations module in the MicroBooNE experiment at FermiLab.

company.name: Columbia University in the City of New York

projects.title: Analysis of Chicago Police Department Complaints Database
projects.description:
-Used clustering, regressions, classifications, and neural nets to analyze and predict officer behavior
-Created visualizations with matplotlib, Tableau, and D3 to explain and expand upon findings
-Queried databases using SQL

projects.title: "Decision Making in the Final Third" -US Soccer Hackathon Project
projects.description: 1st place project completed with team of 5. Used machine learning and data science to evaluate player decision making in the attacking third. Presented at 2018 MLS Innovation Showcase at MLS All-Star Weekend
